DDA JE Result 2026 Out: The Delhi Development Authority (DDA) announced the DDA Junior Engineer Result 10th March 2026. This is the result for the written exam of DDA JE Electrical/Mechanical (post code 16 of Advt. No. 09/2025). Candidates who had appeared for the written exam on 24th December 2025, can download their results from the DDA website @dda.gov.in. Check the DDA JE Result release date, download link, and other details here.

DDA JE Result 2026: Overview

The DDA JE Result 2025-26 has been announced @dda.gov.in. A total of 65 candidates have been shortlisted for the document verification for the Junior Engineer Electrical/Mechanical post. Candidates who appeared for the written test can now check the result to know their qualifying status from the result. It is available on the DDA website in the form of PDF containing the name and roll number-wise list of shortlisted candidates.

DDA Junior Engineer Result 2026: Key Highlights
Exam Conducting Body Delhi Development Authority (DDA)
Post Junior Engineer (JE)
DDA Website dda.gov.in
Vacancies Electrical/Mechanical: 67

Civil: 104
Exam Stages Written Test, Document Verification
Written Exam Date Electrical/Mechanical: 24th December 2026
Result Mode Online
DDA JE Result 2026 Release Dates (Elect/Mech) 10th March 2026

DDA JE Result 2026 Download Link

The DDA Junior Engineer Result 2026 has been announced for the written exam. Candidates can visit the DDA website or use the direct link given below to view their results. The individual marks scored by the candidates are also mentioned along with the result.

Download DDA JE Result 2026 PDF

How to Download DDA JE Result 2026?

Candidates can download the DDA Junior Engineer Result PDF from the commission’s official website only. The steps to download the selection list are explained below.

Step 1. Go to the DDA website @dda.gov.in.

Step 2. Under the ‘What’s New’ section click the DDA JE Result 2026 download link. The result PDF will appear on your screen.

Step 3. Find your roll number or name in the result DDA Junior Engineer Result PDF.

Step 4. Download and save the selection list for reference.

Details Mentioned on the DDA JE Result 2026

The Odisha AAO Result for the written exam has many important details like the roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates, instructions for the next round, etc. Candidates must check the following to avoid any discrepancies later.

  • Name of the exam
  • Exam date and stage
  • Names of the shortlisted candidates
  • Roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates
  • Candidate’s score.

What’s Next After the DDA JE Result 2026?

After the DDA Junior Engineer Result is announced, the shortlisted candidates will be called for verification of the original documents to ensure their eligibility. The final DDA JE Merit List will be released after the interview and document verification.

Hopefully, these details about the DDA JE Result 2026 were helpful and informative. To prepare for the exam, download the Testbook App and get previous year papers, mock tests, and other resources.

FAQs on DDA JE Result 2026

Ques: When will the DDA JE Result 2026 be announced?

Ans: The DDA Junior Engineer Result 2026 was announced on 10th March 2026.

Ques: Is the DDA JE Result sent in hardcopy to the candidates?

Ans: No, the result is announced online only through the DDA website.

Ques: Where can I find the DDA Junior Engineer Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates can download the DDA JE Result PDF from the commission’s website @dda.gov.in.

Ques: What is next after the DDA Junior Engineer Result for the written exam is announced?

Ans: Based on the result of the written exam, the shortlisted candidates will be called for the document verification.

Ques: What are the details mentioned on the DDA JE Result 2026?

Ans: The DDA JE Result PDF contains the roll numbers of the shortlisted candidates. Other details like scores of each candidate, their category, gender, etc., are also mentioned.
